Team / CardioAI,

Thanks for joining today’s MAP checkpoint. Below is a concise status snapshot and the open actions we need closed this week to keep the launch date unchanged (target: 2026-09-14). I attached an updated MAP workbook (MAP_v2.xlsx) and the current runbook draft.

Status summary (green/amber/red):
- Contract & procurement: Amber — PO in progress; procurement has one final question on data retention clauses (Sarah / procurement).
- Dedicated capacity reservations: Green — committed for the 9/14 window.
- Cutover runbook: Amber — draft ready; need final validation from CardioAI ops and a rollback checklist.
- E2E evals: Amber — regression test failed one prompt family; research investigating.

Key open actions (owner — due):
1) Procurement final approval + DocuSign envelope ready — CardioAI Procurement (procurement@cardioai.com) — due 2026-09-01 EOD.
2) Runbook validation and staging drill — CardioAI Ops / Kimberly Park — due 2026-09-06; Kimberly to confirm access and test slot.
3) Fallback model variant validation (quantized fallback) — Ben Carter — due 2026-09-04; provide perf matrix and expected latencies.
4) Cutover timeline & blackout windows (final) — Karthik Iyer — due 2026-09-03; include canary rollout windows and SLA fallback times.
5) Final MAP workbook reconciliation (update milestones + sign-off column) — Tessa Morgan — due 2026-09-02.

Meeting cadence: daily 15-min standups the week of 9/7 (09:00 PDT), and a final dry-run on 2026-09-11 08:00 PDT (full runbook rehearsal).

Please reply with any blockers or if deadlines need to shift — we want one consolidated checklist by 9/2 COB.

Thanks,
Tessa Morgan

Thanks — a few clarifications and schedule notes from the infra side:
- Canary plan: 10% traffic for 12 hours starting 2026-09-14 02:00 PDT; monitor latency, error-rate, and semantic-regression signals (we'll use the eval harness).
- Rollback criteria: automatic rollback if 5xx rate >0.5% sustained for 5m OR semantic-regression on critical prompt set below threshold (see Runbook_draft.md -> Section 4).
- Cutover window: we can do a hard cut at 05:00 PDT on 9/14 if canary is clean, with staged region rollouts completed by 09:00 PDT.

I'll populate the cutover timeline PDF and push version v3 to the shared drive (Cutover_timeline_v3.pdf). Kicking off a staging drill on 2026-09-06 09:00 PDT — Kimberly, can you confirm the slot and whether CardioAI Ops needs our SRE present?

Karthik
